name: Chess
description: Play chess against the computer: full rules, three difficulty levels.

changelog.2.0.0: Now plain Python: nothing to install any more. Full rules, three difficulty levels, record of your games.
changelog.2.0.1: Now says what it can do (permissions: shown before you install, enforced while it runs), is listed in the new categories, and handles Ctrl+C and command-line arguments cleanly.
changelog.2.1.0: New: save and resume, undo, hints, standard notation (type Nf3), move list, PGN export, two players on one keyboard and an expert level with a time limit.
changelog.2.2.0: New: a "difficulty" option (settings app chess) for the level offered first.
